content: With gifts and garments shall friends gladden each other; givers and receivers remain friends the longest.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Vápnum ok váðum skulu vinir gleðjask (Hávamál, Stanza 41) — Poetic Edda
explanation: True camaraderie is neither passive nor one-sided; it thrives on an ongoing rhythm of mutual giving, honor, and heartfelt exchange. In a cold and dangerous world, deliberate acts of generosity weave an unbreakable web of alliance and love that protects both houses against winter.
practicalInsight: Surprise a trusted friend with a thoughtful gift or gesture of appreciation today without waiting for an occasion.
reflectionPrompt: Have you been a gracious giver and receiver in your closest friendships, or has the current become stagnant?
